Slide 14

ICP Synthesis: Defense + Fleet Two-Track (Not a Pivot)
The Paradox
Defense wins on evidence, budget, fit. But worst repeatability (2/5) — contracts are lumpy, don't scale to the 88%-systems-revenue model.
Fleet has the 5M+ market scale. But zero signed customers — needs pilot validation first.
Resolution: Sequenced Two-Track (NOT a flat pivot)
Months 0–6: Defense resourced primary (fastest path to evidence, validates ₹1 Cr revenue nature, proves demand)
Parallel: Fleet runs as secondary experiment (discovery interviews, first pilot pipeline)
Day-90 checkpoint: If Fleet pilot converts, escalate; if not, stay Defense-primary through Series B
Strongest Counter-Case
Defense-first motion risks the narrative built on a 5M+ truck TAM — this ONLY holds as a sequenced two-track plan, never a flat pivot.

Red Team Findings & Critical Conditions
Gap #1: Indian Defense Primes Absent from Competitive Benchmark
A startup vs an established security-cleared incumbent is a different competitive problem than vs Netrasemi/Minus Zero. Action: Add HAL, Bharat Electronics, Godrej Defence to competitor framework.
Gap #2: ₹1 Cr Revenue Nature Unconfirmed
If revenue is grant/subsidy, not commercial sale, re-score Defense ICP as evidence-equal with Fleet. Kill gate: Confirm within 1 week of Series A close.
Circular Evidence Risk
ICP scorecard methodology assumes independence; but Defense evidence (₹1 Cr) is the same revenue that justifies Defense weighting. If revenue is unconfirmed, scoring is circular.
Working Capital Exposure
₹2.48 Cr raised to date vs ₹55 Cr ask. Government payment cycles 90–180+ days. Working capital burn: ~₹15 Cr across FY27–28. Cash flow positive not until FY2029.

GTM Decision: Proceed With Conditions (NOT Unconditional)
Decision Status: PROCEED WITH CONDITIONS
Five Conditions in Priority Order:
Confirm ₹1 Cr revenue nature within 1 week. Commercial sale or grant? Gates Defense resourcing.
Add Indian defense primes to competitive benchmark. HAL, BEL, Godrej Defence assessment by day-30 Series A.
Model working-capital exposure to government payment-cycle delay. Cash flow forecast to profitability (FY2029) under 90–180-day payment assumption.
Keep all external documents in sequenced-plan framing, never flat-pivot narrative. Communicate Defense-first Phase 1 as tactic, not strategy pivot.
Day-90 checkpoint as hard re-scoring gate. If Fleet pilot does not convert by day 90, formally demote; update Series A narrative at that point.
Four Pillars of This Ask
Eliminating the hardware squeeze zone: $30 die + board BOM vs $6,000+ incumbent
De-risked technical validation: FPGA-proven 39.3 TOPS, one open risk (MPW yield)
Non-discretionary mandate capture: India AEBS/ESC Oct 2027 + GCC 2027–2028 mandates
Capital-efficient engineering: $3.17M NRE funded 90% by raise, evidence-gated deployment
